address_convention: Module-relative virtual addresses; corresponding original ELF file offsets equal module address plus 0xc0 for these ranges. End addresses are exclusive. Runtime load base is not included.

conclusion.protagonist_mode: Restores the stored default name initialized from the selected Rexx/Aty default string.
conclusion.nonzero_naming_mode: Cycles deterministically through up to three per-entity preset name pointers, skipping null candidates and the current name.
conclusion.randomization: The analyzed handler and preset lookup do not randomize names.
conclusion.shared_label: Auto-Name accurately covers both branches and is approved for shared button/footer/background artwork.

rejected_shared_labels.Default Name: Describes protagonist restoration but omits the nonzero-mode preset cycling behavior.

conclusion.mode_specific_label: Default Name is semantically valid if used only for protagonist-specific text; no such split is required.

context_fields.0x198: Naming mode; zero selects protagonist defaults.
context_fields.0x41bc: Selected protagonist or nonzero-mode entity identifier.
context_fields.0x421c: Nonzero-mode preset cursor, incremented modulo three.

native_evidence.observation: Clears stored/current name buffers; mode zero loads the Rexx/Aty default into ctx+0x41c0 and copies it to current ctx+0x41e0.
Shared handler; mode-zero restoration and nonzero-mode deterministic preset cycling.

Uses creature/entity index and preset index to return record+0x24+4*preset_index; returns zero when record is absent. No random operation.
Copies zero-terminated 16-bit storage units, corroborating current/default buffer assignments.
